newsitem.title: USA: Best Products secures interim financing.
newsitem.headline: Best Products secures interim financing.

text.p: Best Products Co. said Tuesday the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Richmond, Va., has approved $195 million in interim financing, allowing the jewelry and home furnishings retailer to resume normal operations.

Best Products filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection last week after Ocean Reef Management Inc., a merchant and investment banking firm, withdrew its $63.2 million offer to buy the Richmond, Va.-based retailer.
Prior to that, Sharp Electronics Corp. sued Best Products for payment on about $2.74 million worth of electronics products it had shipped to the company.
The court's decision allows Best Products to use $195 milion of the $250 million unsecured debtor-in-possession facility the company has obtained from the CIT Group/Business Credit Inc.
A hearing to allow Best Products to make full use of the facility is scheduled for Oct. 10.

The company, which operates 169 Best stores in 23 states, had previously filed for bankruptcy protection in January 1991 and emerged in June 1994. It also operates 11 Best Jewelry stores and a nationwide mail-order service.
Best Products had a loss of $31.5 million on sales of $268 million in the quarter ended Aug. 3.
Its stock edged up 6.25 cents to 40.6 cents on Nasdaq at mid-morning.
